stories.title: India’s EV market reaches a new monthly high
stories.summary: September’s record retail figures point to growing demand for electric cars and two-wheelers.
stories.detail: Rediff reports 333,634 EV retail sales across categories in September, up 74% year on year, citing FADA. Electric passenger vehicle sales rose 94.6%, while electric two-wheeler registrations increased 88.7%. These are monthly market figures, rather than a forecast for individual brands.

stories.title: VinFast plans a wider electric two-wheeler network
stories.summary: Dealer agreements set out plans for more than 50 showrooms across India.
stories.detail: Construction World reports that VinFast signed letters of intent covering 34 cities in 15 states and territories. The agreements concern a dedicated electric motorcycle network. They describe planned expansion and should not be read as confirmation that all of these locations are already open.

stories.title: Solar growth puts the spotlight on grid capacity
stories.summary: A new report highlights the importance of delivering clean power as well as generating it.
stories.detail: Reuters, citing CREA, reports that grid constraints prevented absorption of about 4.2% of solar generation in July and August. India curtailed nearly 1.8 billion units of renewable electricity over that period, even as it experienced power shortages.

stories.title: Maharashtra farm project orders 5,000 solar pumps
stories.summary: A new supply order brings standalone solar irrigation back into focus.
stories.detail: Financial Express reports that Saatvik secured an approximately ₹100 crore MSEDCL order under PM-KUSUM B. It covers installation of off-grid pumps and five years of maintenance, warranty and remote monitoring. This is a project order; it does not itself announce a new farmer application window.

stories.title: Audi considers building an electric car in India
stories.summary: Local manufacturing is being evaluated as part of Audi’s India growth strategy.
stories.detail: Business Standard’s PTI report says Audi is considering local battery-electric vehicle production while aiming to expand its luxury-market share over three to five years. The report describes an option under consideration, rather than a confirmed production launch or a model availability date.

stories.title: State solar support sparks more interest in Trichy
stories.summary: Rooftop enquiries and applications have increased following Tamil Nadu’s top-up subsidy announcement.
stories.detail: The Times of India reports that Trichy received 1,020 applications in two months after additional state support was announced under PM Surya Ghar. The report concerns Tamil Nadu; readers elsewhere should check their own state’s rules and electricity distributor before assuming the same support applies.
